description: Turns one 1V/oct pitch into a four-note chord, with a list of stored chords stepped by trigger or picked by voltage

params.text: The note this output carries, dragged round the chromatic circle and shown in volts; a full 360° turn moves it an octave
Drag to transpose every note of the chord in semitones

inputs.text: The voltage here shifts all four outputs, and the chromatic circle is relettered so its top note is the root
A trigger here sets the chord number back to 1
A trigger here steps to the next chord and wraps round to 1 after the last one
0V to 10V picks a chord directly, the range divided evenly between the chords stored, and voltages outside it wrap round. A cable here overrides the chord arrows and the chord menu

outputs.text: 1V/oct pitch for that note of the chord

notes: left-click or right-click the CHORD label to add, duplicate, cut, copy, paste or delete a chord; the arrows either side of it cycle through the list
Rack's own preset menu carries a factory preset named All chords, which fills the list with 36 stored chords, from bare intervals through triads and sevenths to inversions
menu: Sequencer direction — chooses what an ADV trigger does, from Forward, Reverse, Pendulum, Random and Brownian, which moves one chord up or down at random
Polyphonic outputs — makes output 2 carry notes 1 and 2, output 3 notes 1 to 3 and output 4 all four; output 1 is unchanged
